title: Procedural Orientating / Boundary-Front Re-Audit
core_rule: Orientating must be evaluated as a residue-coupled procedure, not as a static orientation observable.
hypothesis: Procedural orientating mediates boundary-front reorganization inside RT(Sigma_R).
forbidden_tests: treating quadrant jitter as direct identity failure
required_tests: ablation of orientating procedure, not merely orientation labels
success_criteria: Orientating sequence is recoverable and residue-coupled.
Boundary-front reorganization correlates with orientating procedural shifts.
RT(Sigma_R) stability is maintained across orientating events.
Whole-expression evaluation avoids the resolution artifacts of prior bridge tests.

falsification_vectors.description: Orientating procedure fails to stabilize boundary-front jitter.
Ablation of orientating procedure (random selection) has no effect on Sigma_R stability.
